item.text: The failure is in `inlineTokens`’ emphasis prepass. It masks backslash escapes before masking code spans, so a backslash immediately before a code delimiter makes that delimiter look escaped and prevents the code span from being masked. The later emphasis scan then sees the span contents and gets confused. I’m reordering these masking steps so code spans are recognized first.
